name: mathtalking
description: MCP server for interactive math graphing, 3D scene building, and presentations. Plot functions (explicit, implicit, parametric, polar), build 3D scenes from 11 mesh shapes + 36 compound presets + mathematical surfaces z=f(x,y), and create slideshows. Returns interactive URLs with inline PNG thumbnails. Mathematically precise, not AI-generated. Zero install, browser-native.

tools.name: plot_graph
tools.description: Plot math functions, points, segments, labels, geometry, and shapes on an interactive graph. Auto-computes roots, extrema, and intersections, and auto-fits the viewport to your data when none is given. Supports gridStyle: 'polar'/'axes'/'none', theme: 'default'/'terminal'/'wallstreet'/'science'/'finance', and looping animations. Incremental building: pass base_render_id to build on an existing graph, remove_indices to drop elements from it. Every result reports what actually landed on the canvas (unreadable expressions, off-screen elements, duplicates, blank graphs).

tools.name: get_graph
tools.description: Retrieve the elements and viewport of an existing 2D graph render by ID. Use it before base_render_id to see what a graph contains, so you can iterate on a graph instead of rebuilding it from scratch.

tools.name: analyze
tools.description: Answer a question about a curve with an exact number — do NOT work it out yourself. Roots, extrema, inflections, intersections, tangent and normal lines, derivatives, integrals, area between curves, arc length, closest point, on explicit, parametric, polar, and implicit curves. Reach for this when the answer IS a number and a graph is optional (pass plot:true to get it drawn with the result already marked). Reach for plot_graph when the answer is a picture.

tools.name: net_generator
tools.description: Unfold a 3D solid into its printable 2D net, and return its volume, surface area, and the worked formulas. Also the right tool when you only want the volume or surface area of a standard solid. Covers cylinder, cube, cone, square pyramid, triangular prism, rectangular prism, and the four Platonic solids. A sphere has no planar net.

tools.name: plot_3d
tools.description: Create interactive 3D scenes with shapes, surfaces z=f(x,y), lights, particles, water, text3d (extruded 3D block letters, CJK supported), and 36 compound presets (buildings, vehicles, nature, furniture, characters). Color-driven building styles (red=Chinese, blue=modern, yellow=cozy, green=eco, brown=rustic). Returns interactive URL with inline PNG thumbnail. Supports animation (spin/bounce/orbit/waypoint/follow), physics, WASD player controls, and skybox presets.

tools.name: get_3d
tools.description: Retrieve the element list of an existing 3D render by ID. Use before base_render_id to inspect what a scene contains. Returns all elements with their properties.

tools.name: create_show
tools.description: Bundle multiple plot_graph results into a slideshow. Returns URL to an interactive presentation with prev/next navigation.
